title: Tests can write into the real data/pending_writes folder
body:
`node-bot/acp-autonomous-loop.js` (around line 63) and `node-bot/server-routes.js` (around line 1237) default the pending-writes folder to `node-bot/data/pending_writes`. At least one test has written a fake approval there, and it showed up as a real approval toast.

Make every test that reaches pending writes pass a temporary folder, and make sure no test falls back to the real one. For example, a test-only guard that fails when the real path is used while `NODE_TEST_CONTEXT` is set would do, if that's the simplest option. Keep the production default the same.
interface: The pending-writes tests (admin-accounts-routes, pending-writes-path-safety) still pass and leave node-bot/data/pending_writes unchanged.
why: One of my live failures: a test's fake approval showed up as a real approval toast.
